description: CVN Carrier operations rules - extracted for carrier mission support

categories.name: Carrier Operations
categories.description: CVN Airboss/George Washington/Stennis flight deck and frequency requirements

rules.name: CVN73 George Washington Frequency
rules.description: CVN73 should broadcast NAV frequency 127.500 MHz, TACAN 73X, ILS 3, Airboss: fsjboss

rules.name: CVN74 Stennis Frequency
rules.description: CVN74 should broadcast NAV frequency 129.00 MHz, TACAN 74X, ILS 4, Airboss: fsjboss

rules.name: Carrier Dynamic Spawn
rules.description: Carrier units must have dynamic spawn enabled for hot starting capability

rules.name: Carrier Hot Start Support
rules.description: Carrier units should allow hot starting for reduced cold start times

rules.name: CVN75 Dwight D. Eisenhower Frequency
rules.description: CVN75 should use 130.50 MHz frequency, TACAN 75X, ILS 5, Airboss: feeboss
